scope: Counted Name::cmp assertions, not elapsed time or byte-comparison counts. Every insertion bound is 11*n*(bit_length(n)+1).
growth_assertion: Successive doubling increases recorded ordered comparisons by at most 2.5x.
large_assertion: At16384 names, recorded ordered comparisons*40 < n*n/2 for each tested shape.
limit: The quick-xml first32 comparison count is not part of this counter; it is bounded by the constant-size prefix. These assertions do not exhibit a hash collision attack.
